notes: placed[].sectionId holds GetLayers COMPOSITION ids (this build places no library Sections); slot 3 uses two compositions together. Route (c) build unique, target 'other' (plain static HTML under a strict CSP: no scripts, no media, fonts self-hosted). Style ridgeline-style re-themed: navy -> Mapfront teal #0f3d3e, marigold #f4b942 as the one accent (pins and the primary action only). Re-typed from Instrument Sans + Geist Mono to one family, Archivo variable (wdth 62-125, wght 100-900), subset and self-hosted at fonts/archivo-var.woff2 (OFL); the mono labels were dropped. The ridgeline template was materialized for rhythm and shape language only (card on a field, radius ladder 32/24/20/12, pill controls, the navy footer with an oversized wordmark); none of its sections, springs or photography were copied, so no 'preserve' layer (motion, composition) was rewritten. No scene, gradient or background: WebGL needs script, which the CSP and tests/test_mapfront_landing.py forbid. Slots: 0 hero (artist-hero split; right plate = Webild-style vertical storefront marquee), 1 package (artist-acquire baseline-split head over a city-block bento), 2 how it works (helion-timeline as a subway line, lettered stops), 3 preview (creative-director-portfolio split + ai-studio-product-card browser mock), 4 close (lumora-footer inverted slab with cropped wordmark). Marquee compositions (vexon-marquee, stride-logo-marquee) were considered and not used: both are logo walls.
